lessons.title: Talking About the Weather

phrases.english: What's the weather like today?
The weather's very hot.
It's cold today.
It's raining outside.
It's cloudy.
There's a lot of wind today.
The weather's humid today.
What do you think, is it going to rain tomorrow?

reply.english: I don't know, but it's cloudy.

phrases.english: It's hot out today.
It's cold out right now.
You need to take an umbrella with you.
The sun's out today.

dialogue.speaker: Rania
dialogue.arabic: صباح الخير يا فادي، شو الجو اليوم برأيك؟
dialogue.transliteration: SabaaH ilkheer ya Faadi, shu ljaw ilyom bra2yak?
dialogue.english: Good morning Fadi, what do you think the weather's like today?

dialogue.speaker: Fadi
dialogue.arabic: صباح النور. الجو مغيم شوي، بس مش برد
dialogue.transliteration: SabaaH innuur. iljaw mghayyim shwayy, bas mish bard
dialogue.english: Good morning. It's a bit cloudy, but not cold.

dialogue.speaker: Rania
dialogue.arabic: يعني رح تشتي برأيك؟
dialogue.transliteration: ya3ni ra7 tishti bra2yak?
dialogue.english: So do you think it'll rain?

dialogue.speaker: Fadi
dialogue.arabic: ما بعرف، بس في هوا كتير من الصبح
dialogue.transliteration: ma ba3rif, bas fi hawa ktiir min iSSub7
dialogue.english: I don't know, but there's been a lot of wind since morning.

dialogue.speaker: Rania
dialogue.arabic: أنا حاسة إنو الدنيا حر أكتر من إمبارح
dialogue.transliteration: ana 7aasse inno iddinye 7arr aktar min imbaare7
dialogue.english: I feel like it's hotter out than yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: Fadi
dialogue.arabic: لأ، أنا حاسس العكس، الجو صار أبرد شوي
dialogue.transliteration: la2, ana 7aasis il3aks, iljaw Saar abrad shwayy
dialogue.english: No, I feel the opposite, the weather's gotten a bit colder.

dialogue.speaker: Rania
dialogue.arabic: المهم، شفتي الشمس طالعة؟
dialogue.transliteration: ilmuhimm, shift ishshams Taal3a?
dialogue.english: Anyway, did you see the sun's out?

dialogue.speaker: Fadi
dialogue.arabic: إي بس مغطاة بالغيم شوي
dialogue.transliteration: ii bas mghaTTaaye bilgheem shwayy
dialogue.english: Yes but it's a bit covered by clouds.

dialogue.speaker: Rania
dialogue.arabic: خد شمسية معك على كل حال
dialogue.transliteration: khod shamsiyye ma3ak 3ala kill 7aal
dialogue.english: Take an umbrella with you just in case.

dialogue.speaker: Fadi
dialogue.arabic: ماشي، منيح إنك ذكرتيني
dialogue.transliteration: maashi, mnii7 innik zakkartiini
dialogue.english: Ok, good you reminded me.

dialogue.speaker: Rania
dialogue.arabic: الله يعطيك العافية، منشوف بعدين
dialogue.transliteration: alla y3aTiik il3aafye, minshuuf ba3deen
dialogue.english: Take care, see you later.

response.english: Yes, bring something heavy with you.
Yes, a lot of wind since morning.

lessons.culture: بدمشق الناس بيحكوا عن الجو كتير كنوع من الحديث الخفيف، خصوصا أول الصباح وقبل ما يطلعوا من البيت. كلمة "الدنيا" بتنستخدم بدل "الجو" بكتير من العبارات، متل "الدنيا حر" أو "الدنيا برد".

exercises.prompt: صاحبك بيسألك: "شو الجو اليوم؟". جاوبه إنو الجو حلو ومشمس.

too_formal.feedback: This is correct but sounds like a formal weather report, not everyday speech.

exercises.prompt: حدا سألك: "عم تشتي هلق؟" وأنت شايف الشمس طالعة. جاوب باللأ.

too_formal.feedback: Grammatically fine, but it is more elaborate and bookish than a quick spoken answer.

exercises.tip: جواب قصير وسريع هو الطبيعي بالحكي اليومي.

exercises.prompt: كمل الجملة: "عم _____ برا من الصبح." المعنى: It's been raining outside since morning.

too_formal.feedback: This is Modern Standard Arabic phrasing, not how rain is described in spoken Damascene.

exercises.tip: الفعل "تشتي" هو الفعل العادي للمطر بالشامي.

exercises.prompt: كمل الجملة: "لازم تاخد _____ معك، رح تشتي." المعنى: You need to take an umbrella with you, it's going to rain.

too_formal.feedback: This is the standard Arabic word for umbrella; Damascenes say "شمسية" in daily speech.

exercises.prompt: ترجم للهجة الدمشقية: "The weather is very cold today."

too_formal.feedback: This is a formal, written-style sentence rather than how it is said in conversation.

exercises.tip: بالحكي اليومي بنقول "بارد" أو "برد" وما منقول "شديد البرودة".

exercises.prompt: ترجم للهجة الدمشقية: "There's a lot of wind today."

too_formal.feedback: Correct meaning, but "الرياح" is the formal written word; spoken Damascene uses "هوا".

exercises.prompt: شو معنى "الجو مغيم"؟

too_formal.feedback: This describes the same meaning but in a formal written register.

exercises.prompt: شو بتقول لحدا لازم ياخد شمسية معه؟

too_formal.feedback: Grammatically correct but far too formal for a casual reminder.

exercises.prompt: رتب الكلمات لتصير جملة: "الجو / مشمس / اليوم / حلو / و"

too_formal.feedback: Same meaning, but this is a more literary, written-style phrasing.

exercises.tip: رتب الوصف بعد كلمة "الجو" واستخدم "و" لربط الصفتين.

exercises.prompt: رتب الكلمات لتصير جملة: "معك / شمسية / تاخد / لازم"

too_formal.feedback: This carries the same meaning but in an unnaturally formal, written tone.

exercises.tip: الجملة العادية تبدأ بـ"لازم" ثم الفعل.

lessons.title: Summer and Winter

phrases.english: What's your favorite season?
In winter it gets very cold in Damascus.
In summer the weather's hot and dry.
It's snowing on the mountain.
Spring is my favorite season.
In fall the leaves fall from the trees.

phrases.arabic: ما بحب الشتا لأنو بيبرد كتير
phrases.transliteration: ma ba7ibb ishshita la2anno byibrad ktiir
phrases.english: I don't like winter because it gets very cold.
What season is it now?
In winter you need to wear something heavy.
The weather changes a lot between the seasons.
I like the smell of rain in spring.
Summer in Damascus is long.

dialogue.speaker: Samer
dialogue.arabic: شو موسمك المفضل يا لينا؟
dialogue.transliteration: shu mawsimak ilmfaDDal ya Leena?
dialogue.english: What's your favorite season, Lina?

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.arabic: بحب الربيع كتير، الجو بيكون معتدل
dialogue.transliteration: ba7ibb irrabii3 ktiir, iljaw byikuun mu3tadil
dialogue.english: I really like spring, the weather's mild.

dialogue.speaker: Samer
dialogue.arabic: أنا بالعكس، بحب الصيف، بحب الحر
dialogue.transliteration: ana bil3aks, ba7ibb iSSayf, ba7ibb il7arr
dialogue.english: I'm the opposite, I like summer, I like the heat.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.arabic: بس بالصيف الجو بيكون جاف كتير بدمشق
dialogue.transliteration: bas biSSayf iljaw byikuun jaaf ktiir b-Dimashq
dialogue.english: But in summer the weather's really dry in Damascus.

dialogue.speaker: Samer
dialogue.arabic: إي صحيح، بس ما بيشتي وهيدا شي منيح
dialogue.transliteration: ii Sa7ii7, bas ma bishti w heeda shi mnii7
dialogue.english: Yeah true, but it doesn't rain and that's a good thing.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.arabic: أنا ما بحب الشتا خالص، بيبرد كتير
dialogue.transliteration: ana ma ba7ibb ishshita khaaliS, byibrad ktiir
dialogue.english: I don't like winter at all, it gets very cold.

dialogue.speaker: Samer
dialogue.arabic: بس بيتلج عالجبل، وهيدا حلو نطلع نتفرج
dialogue.transliteration: bas bitlaj 3aljabal, w heeda 7ilu niTla3 nitfarraj
dialogue.english: But it snows on the mountain, and that's nice to go see.

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.arabic: صحيح، مرة طلعنا عالجبل بالشتا وكان حلو كتير
dialogue.transliteration: Sa7ii7, marra Tla3na 3aljabal bishshita w kaan 7ilu ktiir
dialogue.english: True, once we went up the mountain in winter and it was really nice.

dialogue.speaker: Samer
dialogue.arabic: وشو رأيك بالخريف؟
dialogue.transliteration: w shu ra2yik bilkhariif?
dialogue.english: And what do you think about fall?

dialogue.speaker: Lina
dialogue.arabic: بحب لما الورق يبدأ يوقع، بيصير الجو حلو وهادي
dialogue.transliteration: ba7ibb lamma ilwara2 yibda yuu2a3, biSiir iljaw 7ilu w haadi
dialogue.english: I like when the leaves start falling, the weather becomes nice and calm.

dialogue.speaker: Samer
dialogue.arabic: معك حق، كل موسم إله جماله
dialogue.transliteration: ma3ik 7a22, kill mawsim ilo jamaalo
dialogue.english: You're right, every season has its own beauty.

pair.english: Does it rain a lot in winter?

response.english: Yes, and it snows on the mountain too.

pair.english: What do you think of the summer heat?

response.arabic: بحبو، بس بيصير جاف كتير أحيانا
response.transliteration: ba7ibbo, bas biSiir jaaf ktiir a7yaanan
response.english: I like it, but it gets too dry sometimes.

pair.english: Is fall nice where you are?

response.arabic: إي، بيصير الجو معتدل والورق يوقع
response.transliteration: ii, biSiir iljaw mu3tadil w ilwara2 yuu2a3
response.english: Yes, the weather gets mild and the leaves fall.

lessons.culture: بدمشق الصيف بيكون طويل وحر وجاف، والشتي أو التلج بيصير غالبا من كانون لآذار. التلج عالجبل قريب من المدينة (متل جبل قاسيون) شي بيحب الناس يطلعوا يتفرجوا عليه.

exercises.prompt: حدا سألك: "شو موسمك المفضل؟". جاوب إنك بتحب الصيف.

too_formal.feedback: This is grammatically correct but sounds like a written answer, not spoken conversation.

exercises.prompt: حدا سألك: "هلق شو الموسم؟" وأنت بمنتصف كانون. جاوب إنو الشتا.

too_formal.feedback: This is grammatically fine but far more formal than how the answer is normally given.

exercises.prompt: كمل الجملة: "بالشتا لازم _____ شي تقيل." المعنى: In winter you need to wear something heavy.

too_formal.feedback: This is the formal written word for "wearing"; spoken Damascene uses "لبس".

exercises.tip: كلمة "لبس" هي الكلمة المحكية لـ"يلبس" أو "اللبس".

exercises.prompt: كمل الجملة: "عم _____ عالجبل." المعنى: It's snowing on the mountain.

too_formal.feedback: This is the formal way to describe snowfall; spoken Damascene just says "تتلج".

exercises.prompt: ترجم للهجة الدمشقية: "I don't like winter because it gets very cold."
exercises.answer: ما بحب الشتا لأنو بيبرد كتير
accepted: ما بحب الشتا لأنو بيبرد كتير
ما بحب الشتا لأنه بيبرد كتير
أنا ما بحب الشتا لأنو بيبرد كتير

too_formal.item: لا أحب فصل الشتاء لأن الجو يصبح باردا جدا
too_formal.feedback: This is a correct but written-style sentence, not how it would be spoken.

exercises.prompt: ترجم للهجة الدمشقية: "Spring is my favorite season."
accepted: بحب الربيع أكتر من كل المواسم

too_formal.feedback: Correct meaning, but "فصلي المفضل" is a more written, formal phrasing.

exercises.tip: "أحلى موسم عندي" هي الطريقة المحكية العادية.

exercises.prompt: أي موسم بيتلج فيه عالجبل قريب من دمشق؟

too_formal.feedback: Same meaning, just using the formal written word for winter instead of the spoken one.

exercises.prompt: شو معنى "الجو جاف"؟

too_formal.feedback: Correct meaning but expressed in a formal, written register.

exercises.prompt: رتب الكلمات: "موسم / أحلى / الربيع / عندي"

too_formal.item: الربيع هو أجمل فصل بالنسبة لي
too_formal.feedback: Same meaning but phrased in a more literary, written way.

exercises.prompt: رتب الكلمات: "كتير / بدمشق / طويل / بيكون / الصيف"

too_formal.item: يكون فصل الصيف في دمشق طويلا جدا
too_formal.feedback: This carries the same meaning but in a formal written structure.

exercises.tip: رتب: الموضوع، مكان، فعل، ثم الوصف.

lessons.title: Clothes for the Weather

phrases.english: What should I wear today?
Take an umbrella with you, it's going to rain.
Wear a sweater, it's cold.
In summer I wear shorts and a shirt.
Put on your sunglasses, the sun's strong.

phrases.arabic: لازم بوط بالشتا لأنو بيشتي كتير
phrases.transliteration: lazim buuT bishshita la2anno bishti ktiir
phrases.english: You need boots in winter because it rains a lot.
I didn't wear a jacket and I got cold.
The hat protects you from the sun.
What's your favorite color in sweaters?
In fall I wear a light jacket.

phrases.arabic: لبس شي مريح لأنو رح نمشي كتير
phrases.transliteration: libs shi mrii7 la2anno ra7 nimshi ktiir
phrases.english: Wear something comfortable because we're going to walk a lot.
I forgot the raincoat at home.

dialogue.speaker: Nour
dialogue.arabic: شو لازم البس اليوم؟ ما بعرف شو الجو
dialogue.transliteration: shu lazim ilbas ilyom? ma ba3rif shu ljaw
dialogue.english: What should I wear today? I don't know what the weather's like.

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: الجو برد شوي، لبسي كنزة
dialogue.transliteration: iljaw bard shwayy, libsi kenze
dialogue.english: It's a bit cold, wear a sweater.

dialogue.speaker: Nour
dialogue.arabic: وشمسية لازم؟
dialogue.transliteration: w shamsiyye lazim?
dialogue.english: And do I need an umbrella?

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: إي، رح تشتي بعد الظهر حسب النشرة
dialogue.transliteration: ii, ra7 tishti ba3d iDDuhur 7asab innashra
dialogue.english: Yes, it's going to rain in the afternoon according to the forecast.

dialogue.speaker: Nour
dialogue.arabic: طيب رح لبس بوط كمان، ما بحب رجلي تصير مبلولة
dialogue.transliteration: Tayyeb ra7 albis buuT kamaan, ma ba7ibb rijli tSiir mablule
dialogue.english: Ok I'll wear boots too, I don't like my feet getting wet.

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: فكرة منيحة، وخد جاكيت لأنو رح يبرد بالليل
dialogue.transliteration: fikra mnii7a, w khod jaakeet la2anno ra7 yibrad billeel
dialogue.english: Good idea, and take a jacket because it'll get cold at night.

dialogue.speaker: Nour
dialogue.arabic: نسيت المطرية إمبارح ورجعت مبلول كلي
dialogue.transliteration: nsiit ilmaTariyye imbaare7 w riji3et mablul killi
dialogue.english: I forgot the raincoat yesterday and I came back completely soaked.

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: ولا يهمك، هلق ذكرتك، خدها معك
dialogue.transliteration: wala yhimmak, halla2 zakkartak, khudha ma3ak
dialogue.english: Don't worry, I just reminded you, take it with you.

dialogue.speaker: Nour
dialogue.arabic: شكرا، وشو رأيك بهاد اللون؟ مناسب للجو؟
dialogue.transliteration: shukran, w shu ra2yak bhaad illon? munaasib liljaw?
dialogue.english: Thanks, and what do you think of this color? Is it suitable for the weather?

dialogue.speaker: Omar
dialogue.arabic: إي مناسب، بس خد نضارتك الشمس كمان لأنو الشمس رح تطلع بعدين
dialogue.transliteration: ii munaasib, bas khod naDDaartak ishshams kamaan la2anno ishshams ra7 tiTla3 ba3deen
dialogue.english: Yes it's fine, but take your sunglasses too because the sun will come out later.

dialogue.speaker: Nour
dialogue.arabic: تمام، جهزت كل شي هلق
dialogue.transliteration: tamaam, jahhazet kill shi halla2
dialogue.english: Great, I've got everything ready now.

pair.english: What should I wear, it's cold?

response.english: Wear a sweater and a jacket.

pair.english: Do I need an umbrella today?

response.english: Yes, it's going to rain in the afternoon.

pair.english: What do you wear in summer?

response.english: I wear shorts and a light shirt.

pair.english: Why do you need boots in winter?

response.arabic: لأنو بيشتي كتير وبتصير الأرض مبلولة
response.transliteration: la2anno bishti ktiir w bitSiir ilarD mablule
response.english: Because it rains a lot and the ground gets wet.

lessons.culture: بدمشق الناس بتلبس كذا طبقة بالشتا (كنزة تحت جاكيت) لأنو الجو بيتغير بين الصبح والليل. الشمسية والمطرية شي أساسي بالشنطة أو السيارة من كانون لآذار.

exercises.prompt: صاحبتك سألتك: "شو لازم البس اليوم؟" وانت عارف الجو برد. جاوبها.

too_formal.feedback: This is grammatically fine but is written-register phrasing, not casual spoken advice.

exercises.tip: "البس شي تقيل" هي النصيحة المحكية العادية.

exercises.prompt: حدا سألك: "لازم شمسية اليوم؟" وأنت عارف رح تشتي. جاوب بالإيجاب.

too_formal.feedback: This is a formal weather-report style answer rather than a quick spoken reply.

exercises.prompt: كمل الجملة: "حط _____ الشمس، الشمس قوية." المعنى: Put on your sunglasses, the sun is strong.

too_formal.feedback: This is the correct object but phrased as a formal noun label, not spoken instruction.

exercises.prompt: كمل الجملة: "نسيت _____ بالبيت." المعنى: I forgot the raincoat at home.

too_formal.feedback: This is a formal descriptive phrase rather than the single common spoken word.

exercises.prompt: ترجم للهجة الدمشقية: "You need boots in winter because it rains a lot."
exercises.answer: لازم بوط بالشتا لأنو بيشتي كتير
accepted: لازم بوط بالشتا لأنو بيشتي كتير
لازم بوط بالشتا لأنه بيشتي كتير
بالشتا لازم بوط لأنو بيشتي كتير

too_formal.item: يجب ارتداء الأحذية المطرية في الشتاء لأن الأمطار تهطل كثيرا
too_formal.feedback: Correct meaning, but this is a formal written sentence.

exercises.prompt: ترجم للهجة الدمشقية: "I didn't wear a jacket and I got cold."

too_formal.feedback: Same meaning but written in a formal literary structure.

exercises.prompt: شو بتلبس بالصيف عادة؟

too_formal.feedback: Correct meaning but a more elaborate, written phrasing of the same clothes.

exercises.tip: بالصيف الجو حر فبنلبس لبس خفيف.

exercises.prompt: ليش بتلبس نضارة الشمس؟

too_formal.feedback: Correct meaning but phrased with the more formal word "أشعة".

exercises.tip: النضارة بتحمي عيونك من الشمس القوية.

exercises.prompt: رتب الكلمات: "معك / شمسية / تشتي / رح / خد"

too_formal.item: خذ معك مظلة لأن الأمطار ستهطل
too_formal.feedback: Same meaning but with formal connectors and vocabulary.

exercises.prompt: رتب الكلمات: "بالبيت / المطرية / نسيت"

too_formal.item: لقد نسيت معطف المطر في المنزل
too_formal.feedback: Same meaning, more formal sentence construction with "لقد".

exercises.tip: ابدأ بالفعل "نسيت" ثم الشيء ثم المكان.

lessons.title: Going Out Depends on the Weather

phrases.english: If the weather's nice, we'll go out to the park.

phrases.arabic: الجو مش منيح، بدنا نلغي الطلعة
phrases.transliteration: iljaw mish mnii7, badna nilghi iTTal3a
phrases.english: The weather's not good, we need to cancel the outing.
What do you think about staying home today?
If it rains tomorrow, we'll postpone the trip.
The weather's nice, let's go out for a walk.

phrases.arabic: ما فيني اطلع، الجو حر كتير
phrases.english: I can't go out, it's too hot.

phrases.arabic: رح نقعد عالشرفة الليلة، الجو لطيف
phrases.english: We'll sit on the balcony tonight, the weather's pleasant.

phrases.arabic: لأنو رح تشتي، خلينا نأجل السهرة
phrases.transliteration: la2anno ra7 tishti, khalliina naajjil issahra
phrases.english: Since it's going to rain, let's postpone the evening gathering.
The weather doesn't allow us to play outside.
As long as the weather's good, we'll keep going out.
The trip to the mountain depends on the weather.
Did you see the weather forecast?

reply.arabic: إي، قالوا رح تشتي بعد الظهر
reply.english: Yes, they said it'll rain in the afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: Hala
dialogue.arabic: شو رأيك نطلع عالحديقة اليوم؟
dialogue.transliteration: shu ra2yik niTla3 3al7adiiqa ilyom?
dialogue.english: What do you think about going out to the park today?

dialogue.speaker: Karim
dialogue.arabic: شفتي نشرة الجو؟ أنا سمعت رح تشتي بعد الظهر
dialogue.transliteration: shifti nashret iljaw? ana sim3et ra7 tishti ba3d iDDuhur
dialogue.english: Did you see the weather forecast? I heard it's going to rain in the afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: Hala
dialogue.arabic: لأ ما شفتها، بس الجو هلق حلو كتير
dialogue.transliteration: la2 ma shiftha, bas iljaw halla2 7ilu ktiir
dialogue.english: No I didn't see it, but the weather's really nice right now.

dialogue.speaker: Karim
dialogue.arabic: إذا الجو منيح لهلق، يلا نطلع بسرعة قبل ما يتغير
dialogue.transliteration: iza iljaw mnii7 lahalla2, yalla niTla3 bsur3a 2abil ma yitghayyar
dialogue.english: If the weather's good for now, let's go out quickly before it changes.

dialogue.speaker: Hala
dialogue.arabic: طيب، بس إذا شتي منرجع عالبيت مباشرة
dialogue.transliteration: Tayyeb, bas iza shiti minirja3 3albeet mubaashara
dialogue.english: Ok, but if it rains we'll go back home right away.

dialogue.speaker: Karim
dialogue.arabic: ماشي. وشو منسوي إذا الجو ما بيسمح؟
dialogue.transliteration: maashi. w shu minsawwi iza iljaw ma byismah?
dialogue.english: Alright. And what will we do if the weather doesn't allow it?

dialogue.speaker: Hala
dialogue.arabic: منأجل الطلعة ومنقعد بالبيت نتفرج ع فيلم
dialogue.transliteration: minaajjil iTTal3a w minu23od bilbeet nitfarraj 3a fiilim
dialogue.english: We'll postpone the outing and stay home to watch a movie.

dialogue.speaker: Karim
dialogue.arabic: فكرة حلوة، بس بتمنى الجو يضل منيح
dialogue.transliteration: fikra 7ilwe, bas bitmanna iljaw yiDall mnii7
dialogue.english: Good idea, but I hope the weather stays nice.

dialogue.speaker: Hala
dialogue.arabic: أنا كمان، طالما الجو منيح منضل طالعين
dialogue.transliteration: ana kamaan, Talama iljaw mnii7 minDall Tal3iin
dialogue.english: Me too, as long as the weather's good we'll keep going out.

dialogue.speaker: Karim
dialogue.arabic: طيب والرحلة عالجبل يوم الجمعة، شو رأيك؟
dialogue.transliteration: Tayyeb w irri7le 3aljabal yom iljim3a, shu ra2yik?
dialogue.english: Ok and the trip to the mountain on Friday, what do you think?

dialogue.speaker: Hala
dialogue.arabic: هاي كمان رهن الجو، بشوف النشرة يوم الخميس
dialogue.transliteration: hayy kamaan rahn iljaw, bshuuf innashra yom ilkhamiis
dialogue.english: That also depends on the weather, I'll check the forecast on Thursday.

pair.english: Are we going out to the park today?
Why do you want to cancel the outing?

response.arabic: لأنو الجو مش منيح ورح تشتي
response.transliteration: la2anno iljaw mish mnii7 w ra7 tishti
response.english: Because the weather's not good and it's going to rain.

pair.english: Did you see the forecast for Friday?

response.arabic: إي، قالوا الجو رح يكون منيح
response.english: Yes, they said the weather will be nice.

pair.arabic: شو منسوي إذا الجو ما بيسمح؟
pair.transliteration: shu minsawwi iza iljaw ma byismah?
pair.english: What do we do if the weather doesn't allow it?

response.english: We stay home and postpone the trip.

lessons.culture: بدمشق كتير خطط الطلعات، السهرات ورحلات الجبل مرتبطة بالجو، فالناس بتحب تتابع نشرة الجو قبل ما تخطط. لما الجو ما بيسمح، الحل العادي إنو الأهل والأصحاب يأجلوا الطلعة مش يلغوها نهائي.

exercises.prompt: صاحبك سألك: "شو رأيك نقعد بالبيت اليوم؟" والجو برد كتير برا. وافق.

too_formal.item: موافق، فالأجواء شديدة البرودة في الخارج
too_formal.feedback: This is grammatically fine but reads as a written, formal sentence.

exercises.prompt: حدا سألك: "شفت نشرة الجو؟" وإنت شفتها وعرفت رح تشتي بعد الظهر. جاوب.
exercises.answer: إي، قالوا رح تشتي بعد الظهر
accepted: إي، قالوا رح تشتي بعد الظهر
إي، شفتها، رح تشتي بعد الظهر

too_formal.item: نعم، أفادت النشرة الجوية بهطول أمطار بعد الظهر
too_formal.feedback: This is correct but far more formal than a casual spoken reply.

exercises.tip: جاوب بـ"إي" ثم لخص الخبر بسرعة.

exercises.prompt: كمل الجملة: "إذا الجو منيح، _____ عالحديقة." المعنى: If the weather's nice, we'll go out to the park.

too_formal.feedback: This is the formal written way to say "we'll head to", not the spoken form.

exercises.prompt: كمل الجملة: "الرحلة عالجبل _____ الجو." المعنى: The trip to the mountain depends on the weather.

too_formal.feedback: Same meaning but built with formal passive construction.

exercises.prompt: ترجم للهجة الدمشقية: "The weather doesn't allow us to play outside."
accepted: الجو ما بيسمح إلنا نلعب برا

too_formal.item: لا يسمح الطقس لنا باللعب في الخارج
too_formal.feedback: Correct meaning, but this is formal written word order.

exercises.prompt: ترجم للهجة الدمشقية: "As long as the weather's good, we'll keep going out."
accepted: طالما الجو منيح، رح نضل طالعين

too_formal.feedback: Same meaning but with formal future construction "سنستمر".

exercises.prompt: شو بيعملوا الناس إذا الجو ما بيسمح بالطلعة؟

too_formal.feedback: Correct meaning but a more formal way to describe the same action.

exercises.tip: العادة إنو الطلعة تتأجل مش تتلغي نهائي.

exercises.prompt: شو معنى "الرحلة رهن الجو"؟

too_formal.feedback: Same meaning stated in a formal, written way.

exercises.tip: "رهن" معناها معلقة أو معتمدة على شي.

exercises.prompt: رتب الكلمات: "عالحديقة / منيح / الجو / إذا / منطلع"

too_formal.item: إذا كانت حالة الطقس جيدة سنذهب إلى الحديقة
too_formal.feedback: Same meaning but a formal written sentence structure.

exercises.tip: ابدأ بـ"إذا" ثم الشرط ثم النتيجة.

exercises.prompt: رتب الكلمات: "الجو / نشرة / شفت"

too_formal.feedback: Same meaning but a formal written question form.

exercises.tip: ابدأ بالفعل "شفت" ثم الشيء الذي شفته.

challenge.title: Plan Your Day Around the Weather
challenge.instructions: Write and say a short Damascene conversation, at least 10 lines, between two friends deciding what to do today based on the weather. It must include asking about the weather, describing the weather with at least two different weather words, a question about the season, advice on what to wear, and a decision on whether to go out or stay home.
required_elements: A question asking what the weather is like, using شو الجو.
At least two different weather descriptions, such as حر, برد, مغيم, or عم تشتي.
A mention of the season, using a word like الصيف, الشتا, الربيع, or الخريف.
Advice on what to wear, using لازم تلبس or a similar phrase.
A decision using إذا الجو منيح or إذا الجو مش منيح.
A line using لازم تاخد شمسية or a similar reminder.
A final decision to go out (منطلع) or stay home (منقعد بالبيت).

dialogue.speaker: Yara
dialogue.arabic: صباح الخير، شو الجو اليوم؟
dialogue.transliteration: SabaaH ilkheer, shu ljaw ilyom?
dialogue.english: Good morning, what's the weather like today?

dialogue.speaker: Bilal
dialogue.arabic: صباح النور، الجو مغيم شوي بس مش برد كتير
dialogue.transliteration: SabaaH innuur, iljaw mghayyim shwayy bas mish bard ktiir
dialogue.english: Good morning, it's a bit cloudy but not too cold.

dialogue.speaker: Yara
dialogue.arabic: هلق نحن بالخريف صح؟ لهيك الورق عم يوقع
dialogue.transliteration: halla2 ni7na bilkhariif Sa7? lahiik ilwara2 3am yuu2a3
dialogue.english: We're in fall now right? That's why the leaves are falling.

dialogue.speaker: Bilal
dialogue.arabic: إي صحيح، وبيبرد شوي بالليل بهالموسم
dialogue.transliteration: ii Sa7ii7, w byibrad shwayy billeel bhalmawsim
dialogue.english: Yeah, and it gets a bit cold at night in this season.

dialogue.speaker: Yara
dialogue.arabic: شفت نشرة الجو؟ في احتمال شتي بعد الظهر
dialogue.transliteration: shift nashret iljaw? fi i7timaal shiti ba3d iDDuhur
dialogue.english: Did you see the forecast? There's a chance of rain in the afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: Bilal
dialogue.arabic: لأ ما شفتها، بس خد معك شمسية على كل حال
dialogue.transliteration: la2 ma shiftha, bas khod ma3ak shamsiyye 3ala kill 7aal
dialogue.english: No I didn't see it, but take an umbrella with you just in case.

dialogue.speaker: Yara
dialogue.arabic: لازم تلبس جاكيت خفيف كمان، الجو رح يتغير
dialogue.transliteration: lazim tilbas jaakeet khafiif kamaan, iljaw ra7 yitghayyar
dialogue.english: You also need to wear a light jacket, the weather's going to change.

dialogue.speaker: Bilal
dialogue.arabic: طيب، إذا الجو منيح لهلق منطلع نتمشى شوي
dialogue.transliteration: Tayyeb, iza iljaw mnii7 lahalla2 minTla3 nitmashsha shwayy
dialogue.english: Ok, if the weather's still good let's go out for a short walk.

dialogue.speaker: Yara
dialogue.arabic: وإذا بلش يشتي؟
dialogue.transliteration: w iza balash yishti?
dialogue.english: And if it starts raining?

dialogue.speaker: Bilal
dialogue.arabic: منرجع عالبيت على طول
dialogue.transliteration: minirja3 3albeet 3ala Tuul
dialogue.english: We'll head straight back home.

dialogue.speaker: Yara
dialogue.arabic: ماشي، يلا نطلع هلق قبل ما يتغير الجو
dialogue.transliteration: maashi, yalla niTla3 halla2 2abil ma yitghayyar iljaw
dialogue.english: Ok, let's go out now before the weather changes.
